title: 1904: nobody believed this painting was real #Shorts
description:
In the summer of 1903 painter Frederick Dellenbaugh came to Zion. His canvases were shown at the 1904 World's Fair in St. Louis, where visitors reportedly doubted a place like that could be real.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
